title: Anand
desc: Dr. Bhaskar Bannerjee struggles with his patients' suffering and the darkness and poverty he confronts daily in India. He treats a cancer patient, who learning of his illness decides to use the time he has left to the fullest.

title: Golmaal
desc: Ramprasad works for Bhavani, who discourages his employees from pursuing any hobbies. Things take a hilarious turn when Bhavani catches Ramprasad at a hockey match and he lies about having a twin.

title: Azaad Desh Ke Ghulam
desc: When law student Bharti discovers that her father's wealth comes from illegal and immoral activities, she makes a deadly decision to escape that life and draws the attention of a plotting maternal uncle.

title: Badi Bahen
desc: Jyoti, a girl found by the riverbank, is adopted by a gardener who works for a wealthy family. Years later, she finally finds her true identity amidst love, deceit and twists of fate.
